b: This trim was only 2 years old. I know plastic trim moves a lot more than wood but this is a first for me. When I pushed it back down there was almost a 1/4" gap. I believe it's because whoever installed it put a row of 3 3" nails across the middle of the board which created a weak point. I put in a new piece which involved talking the door and hinges off and removing the broken piece, then putting a new piece up and then putting the whole door back up.
And yes I staggered the nails. Both hinges have 8 big ass lags going through to the framing which is why I think it pulled itself apart in the middle.
